training_stack: mjlab 1.3.0 (MuJoCo Warp), PPO via RSL-RL, trained with pollen-robotics/microduck_rl

contract.obs_layout: ang_vel 0:3, projected_gravity 3:6, joint_pos_rel 6:20, joint_vel 20:34, last_action 34:48, command 48:61 (twist 3 + head_pose 4 + body_pose 6)
contract.obs_normalization: empirical normalizer BAKED INTO the ONNX (exported with microduck_rl scripts/export.py) -- feed raw observations
contract.gravity_input: projected gravity (infer_policy.py CLI default), NOT the raw accelerometer

round_3.walk_teacher: walk v2: velocity task retrained from scratch with sharp xy + yaw tracking terms added next to the stock ones and in-place turn commands down to 0.1 rad/s; logs/rsl_rl/velocity/2026-11-01_17-21-17_walkv2_chunk2/model_7998.pt (8,000 iterations, 4096 envs)
round_3.stand_teacher: spin-capped StandUp expert: supportgate run resumed 3999 -> 11998 with a trunk spin penalty ReLU(|w| - 6 rad/s)^2 ramped to -0.2; logs/rsl_rl/microduck_stand/2026-11-01_17-21-18_spincap_chunk2/model_11000.pt
round_3.velstand: 4,000 iterations, 2,048 envs, warm-started from walk v2 (MICRODUCK_WARM_START=1), BC from the spin-capped expert on fallen frames and walk v2 on upright frames, walk v2 fed a command lookup table (WALKV2_ANCHOR_TWIST_REMAP) -> model_3999

lineage.round_2: plain resume of round 1 (3000 -> 6999), old walk model_4750 as anchor fed LOCAL_ANCHOR_TWIST_REMAP -> model_6750
lineage.round_1: 4,000 iterations warm-started from the old walk (velocity model_4750), stand teacher supportgate/model_3500 -> model_3000
lineage.code: github.com/dillonfaulk/microduck_rl, branch local/velstand-own-teachers (round 3: commits 25b011ef code, 4f629d66 + 5784bec9 runs/scripts; rounds 1-2: 6bc72eba, f19c6ae8), based on pollen-robotics/microduck_rl b02fdea

drive: cd microduck_rl && uv run python scripts/infer_policy.py --new-cmd-obs --scene src/mjlab_microduck/robot/microduck/scene_allcollisions.xml --walking <onnx>. Do NOT use logs/drive_remap.py (calibrated for model_3000).

measured_results_round3_model_3999.cpu_sim: fixed harness (BAM actuator, 1-step delay, training solver, allcollisions scene): get-ups 48/48 fallen starts (face-down, face-up, left, right, sitting all 8/8); no falls in any walking test; fwd 0.30 -> 0.31 m/s, back 0.20 -> 0.23, strafe 0.15 -> 0.13, turn 1.0 -> 1.03 / -1.19 rad/s, turn right 0.5 -> 0.48, fwd 0.2 + turn 0.5 -> 0.21 / 0.53
measured_results_round3_model_3999.training_sim: prone get-ups 99.3% / 100% (1024 envs, 20 s); knocked over while walking -> back up 96.4%; rise-only face-up peak trunk |w| 9.4 rad/s median (round 2: 13.6); fwd 0.15-0.25 m/s ~1:1, back 0.20/0.25 -> 0.23/0.25, strafe +-0.10 -> 0.11/-0.10, in-place turn +-1.0 -> 0.96/-1.05

measured_results_round2_model_6750.training_sim: get-ups 99.0% / 99.5%; rise-only face-up peak trunk |w| 13.6 rad/s median; fwd 0.1-0.25 ~1:1, back 0.20 -> 0.13, strafe 0.10 -> 0.03

known_weaknesses: SIM ONLY -- never run on the physical robot
0.10 m/s forward/backward does nothing; in the CPU sim 0.15 m/s forward from standstill also does nothing (works in the training sim)
turns in place at 0.4 rad/s or slower do nothing; left 0.5 rad/s in the CPU sim reaches only 0.29
backing up still curves slightly in the CPU sim (-0.16 rad/s at 0.2 m/s back)
rising from a sitting start still peaks around 13 rad/s trunk spin
